option_relations.rationale: Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa (DEB) is a broader category that includes Recessive Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa (RDEB) with revertant mosaicism.
Recessive Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa (RDEB) is a broader category that includes RDEB with revertant mosaicism.
Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa with Revertant Mosaicism is a broader category that includes the specific type of Recessive Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa with revertant mosaicism.

The option 'Severe generalized recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa (RDEB) with revertant mosaicism' is clinically equivalent to the provided leaf '隐性营养不良型大疱性表皮松解症（RDEB）伴体细胞逆转镶嵌（revertant mosaicism）' which translates to 'Recessive Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa (RDEB) with somatic revertant mosaicism'.
